acceptance_criteria.text: A firehose tape PARSER reads the local Jun 20-23 lake (/Users/asim/NoIcloud/solanatrills/lake/firehose/dt=2026-06-2{0,1,2,3}/part-0.jsonl.gz, or a copy vendored into the repo's test-data path) and yields the documented row schema (mint, block_time unix-s, slot, signature, price SOL/token, side, vol, vol_sol, vol_usd, owner, phase). It SKIPS-AND-COUNTS-AND-FLAGS unparseable partial-write lines (~2-10%/day) — a malformed line is never fatal and never silently dropped; the parser returns/logs the bad-line count. Verified: a test over a fixture slice (incl. deliberately-planted malformed lines) asserts the good rows parse, the bad-line counter equals the planted count, and no exception escapes. CORRECTION (do NOT mischaracterize): phase:'post' rows are VALID post-grad swaps, NOT partial-write corruption -- they simply carry a DIFFERENT schema (NO mint/vol_sol; they DO carry rel=seconds-since-grad + a populated vol_usd). The parser must (i) count genuine unparseable partial-write lines separately from (ii) valid post rows, skip post rows from pre-curve analysis WITHOUT counting them as bad/corrupt, and OPTIONALLY expose a separate `post` stream. The bad-line counter must NOT include valid post rows. See US-92 for the recorder fix that adds mint to post rows.

A FREE graduation LABELER computes, per mint, cumulative BUY vol_sol and labels a mint GRADUATED at the block_time where cumulative buy vol_sol first crosses the threshold (~85 SOL, a single named constant). This is the zero-credit, full-population graduation LABEL derived from the PRE (bonding-curve) rows (graduation OUTCOME = the curve-completion crossing). NOTE: post-grad IS captured abundantly in these tapes (phase 'post', ~38k rows on Jun-22, rel=seconds-since-grad) -- the earlier 'post not captured / only ~13 grads' claim was WRONG -- but post rows carry NO mint (see US-92), so the offline grad LABEL is computed from the pre rows; post rows are used for outcome/exit attribution only AFTER US-92 adds the mint. Verified: a test over a fixture asserts (a) a mint whose cumulative buy vol_sol reaches the threshold is labeled graduated at the correct crossing block_time, (b) a mint that never reaches it is labeled not-graduated, and (c) the labeler reports a plausible window-level grad count from the pre rows (the label must NOT depend on the post rows, which are mint-less until US-92).

A DOLLAR-BASIS helper converts SOL quantities to USD as vol_sol x SOL_price, with the SOL price pinned in ONE config-driven place (a per-day constant or series; default ~$84/SOL for this window per the MANIFEST). vol_usd (all-zero in these tapes) is NEVER read for a dollar value anywhere in the harness or any consumer. Verified: a test asserts the helper dollarizes a known vol_sol correctly at the pinned price, and a repo-wide guard/test asserts no harness-or-consumer code path reads vol_usd for a dollar quantity (e.g. an AST/grep guard flags `vol_usd` reads in the dollar-deriving modules). The harness exposes a clean API (parse / label_graduations / to_usd) that US-80 and every Phase-B story imports — it is the single referenced foundation. Zero firehose.

stories.title: PHASE B (COPY, THE EDGE) — Classifier calibration / train-serve parity: run a G2 parity table (live entry_features vs lab parquets), find the P(grad) inflation source, and recalibrate the gate-3 threshold to the LIVE top-25% so the selection gate is actually selective on the local tapes

acceptance_criteria.text: A G2 TRAIN/SERVE PARITY TABLE is produced: live-computed entry_features (the curvestage feature port over the LOCAL recorder tapes via the US-81 harness) are diffed distribution-by-distribution (per-feature median + quantiles) against the lab Birdeye parquets that trained the seed classifier. The prime suspects price_at_entry and fdv_proxy (USD-basis features — Helius price is a SOL/token ratio; the lab's is USD/token) are called out explicitly and the table identifies WHERE the live distribution diverges from the lab. Verified by a committed parity-table artifact + a test asserting the table is generated from the local tapes (zero firehose) and that the basis-sensitive features are computed on the vol_sol x SOL_price USD basis (US-81.3), never vol_usd.

The P(grad) INFLATION SOURCE is identified and the fix documented: the seed classifier (trained on lab parquets) currently predicts median P(grad) ~0.71 but the live realized grad-rate is ~25% (over-confident ~3x), and the frozen lab threshold 0.153 sits far below the live score mass so it admits ~every trigger (a no-op gate ~= the on-curve base rate ~24%). The story pins the cause to the parity break (e.g. the price_at_entry/fdv_proxy basis) and either (a) corrects the live feature computation to restore parity, or (b) recalibrates, with the choice documented. Verified by a test/artifact showing the corrected live P(grad) distribution and the documented decision.

LOCAL-PROOF — the gate is RECALIBRATED to the LIVE top-25% and PROVEN SELECTIVE on the local tapes: the new threshold is computed from the live score mass (top-~25% among on-curve+curve_frac<=0.6 gated candidates), is config-driven (a single named constant, not a scattered literal), and a committed test asserts that on the Jun 20-23 tapes the SELECTED-cohort graduation rate (using the US-81 free cum-vol_sol>=85 label) is STRICTLY GREATER than the on-curve base rate (~24%) — i.e. the gate actually selects, it is no longer a no-op. HONEST CAVEAT recorded in the story notes: even recalibrated, live ranking is weak (grad picks median pgrad ~0.84 vs non-grad ~0.68, heavy overlap) — this fix gets curvestage to 'properly tested', NOT 'proven'. Zero firehose; dollars via vol_sol x SOL_price.

stories.title: PHASE B (COPY) — Settler honesty: switch curvestage graduation detection from the blind recorder tokens table to GROUND TRUTH (live = the corrected on-chain detector US-86; offline re-settle = cum-vol_sol>=85) so graduated tokens stop riding to false TIMER/-100%

acceptance_criteria.text: ROOT CAUSE pinned + reconciled: curvestage_engine._graduation_bt reads graduation ONLY from the recorder `tokens` table, which is blind to ~18/24 grads, so graduated tokens ride to a false AUTO_SELL_TIMER / -100% settle (this is why the dashboard shows -$265 while the honest re-settle is -$172.72). The story explicitly RECONCILES the production design vs the diagnostic: for LIVE/production the settler reads graduation from the CORRECTED ON-CHAIN detector (US-86, MigrateV2 + PumpSwap CreatePool — free, push, authoritative), NOT a Birdeye REST poll (that was a one-off diagnostic correction, NOT the production design). For OFFLINE re-settle, graduation comes from the US-81 free cum-vol_sol>=85 label. Verified by a test asserting the engine no longer treats a known-graduated mint as a TIMER/-100% exit.

The OFFLINE re-settle path (the salvaged resettle probe / settler) detects graduation via the US-81 cum-vol_sol>=85 label and settles a graduated position at the graduation/migration exit (the curvestage ride-to-grad exit), NOT a false -100% timer. Verified by a test over the local tapes asserting that the ~18 previously-mis-settled graduated tokens from the diagnostic cohort now settle as graduations (positive or graduation-priced exits), reproducing the honest re-settle figures (-$172.72 / 25% grad / 21% win) within a documented tolerance.

LOCAL-PROOF + isolation: a committed regression test pins the corrected settler behavior on a fixture slice (graduated mint -> graduation exit; non-graduated mint -> the existing TP/SL/curve/timer logic unchanged), the dollar basis is vol_sol x SOL_price (never vol_usd), and the change is SS5-isolated (touches only copytrade settlement, no shared mutable state with the firehose/model pipeline, copytrade isolation guards stay GREEN). Zero firehose. Honest exit price comes from the firehose tape (fill_repricing window rule), never a fake settler price.

stories.title: PHASE B (COPY) — Wire the weekly retrain on the recorder's OWN on-curve tapes (date-gated no-op until the lake hits >=7 days; do NOT block on the date gate)

acceptance_criteria.text: The weekly-retrain job (retrain_curvestage_classifier celery-beat task) is WIRED to rebuild the P(grad) training set from the recorder's OWN prior-week on-curve entries in the firehose lake (pool-wallet >=$250 first-buys via vol_sol x SOL_price, the US-82 entry_features, and the US-81 cum-vol_sol>=85 graduation label), retrain the LGBM, and refresh the frozen threshold from a held-out fold. The $250 filter and all dollar quantities derive from vol_sol x SOL_price, never vol_usd. Verified by a test exercising the retrain over a local-tape fixture week (produces a model + a threshold).

The job is DATE-GATED and does NOT block the sprint: it is a documented no-op until the lake has >=7 days of on-curve entries (currently ~3-4 days locally), at which point it takes over from the lab seed; until then the US-82 recalibrated seed carries. Verified by a test asserting the job no-ops (and logs the date gate) when fed <7 days of data and runs when fed >=7 days. The story NOTES the date gate explicitly and is NOT blocked on lake maturity.

LOCAL-PROOF: a committed test drives the full retrain path over a synthetic-or-sliced >=7-day local-tape fixture and asserts it produces a model artifact + a held-out-derived threshold, with the new threshold computed on the live score mass (parity with US-82's top-25% methodology). The retrained-vs-seed threshold handoff is deterministic and logged. Zero firehose.

stories.title: PHASE B (COPY) — Re-soak validation harness + kill-switch definition: observe/paper only, judged by honest-fill re-settle (NEVER the dashboard), with the kill-switch = selected grad-rate < 40% over >=15 trades

acceptance_criteria.text: A re-soak validation harness re-runs the recalibrated curvestage gate (US-82) + honest settler (US-83) over the LOCAL Jun 20-23 tapes in observe/paper mode (trading_enabled=false, $25 book) and reports the soak metrics judged by HONEST-FILL re-settle via fill_repricing.py (entry/exit priced from the firehose tape, NEVER the dashboard number): selected grad-rate, win-rate, net $/tr. The KILL-SWITCH is defined and implemented as a config-driven health monitor: kill the soak if the selected grad-rate (denominator counting ONLY real on-curve entries — NOT VOID/ENTRY_REJECTED rows; the curvestage_hc.sh denominator bug is fixed) drops below 40% over >=15 trades (offline was 60-69%). The grad-rate is the FAST leading health metric (converges before PnL). Verified by a test feeding a synthetic trade stream that trips the kill below 40%/>=15 and does NOT trip above it, with VOID/ENTRY_REJECTED rows correctly excluded from the denominator.

LOCAL-PROOF + HONEST CAVEAT recorded: the harness reproduces the documented honest-fill direction (the recalibrated gate's selected grad-rate exceeds the ~24% base rate per US-82; net is still break-even-to-negative on weak live ranking) and the story records the honest caveat that this gets curvestage to 'properly tested', NOT 'proven'. The soak judgment trinity is documented: (a) judge on firehose-reconstructed real fills, never the dashboard; (b) selected grad-rate vs ~39% breakeven is the leading kill metric; (c) net $/tr after honest fill. Zero firehose.

stories.title: PHASE B (MODEL, FOUNDATIONAL) — Decide the graduation detector by MATCH-RATE against the completeevent-derived ground truth (seed_recent.csv), NOT by doc precedence: score BOTH candidate detectors (Instruction:Migrate substring vs precise MigrateV2 + PumpSwap CreatePool) offline over local fixtures and ship the higher precision/recall — killing the near-zero post-grad tagging

acceptance_criteria.text: DECIDE BY MATCH-RATE, NOT DOC PRECEDENCE. Score BOTH candidate detectors offline over a historical window and compare their detected graduations (tokens + timing) against the canonical completeevent-derived ground-truth grad set: (A) the deployed `Instruction: Migrate` substring matcher, vs (B) precise `MigrateV2` + PumpSwap `CreatePool` (pAMMBay...) instruction matching. GROUND TRUTH (FREE/local, NO CREDITS): `/Users/asim/NoIcloud/solanabilly3/data/graduated/seed_recent.csv` (Jun 13-21, ~1805 graduated mints with t0_unix, itself derived from Dune pump_evt_completeevent — Dune is 402/out-of-credits so this CSV is the stand-in). Do NOT use Birdeye pump_amm pool-creation as the stand-in (it costs credits; hard-no-credits sprint). Compute precision + recall (tokens matched, and timing within a documented tolerance) for each detector vs seed_recent. SHIP the detector with the better precision/recall. Verified by a committed scoring artifact + test reporting both detectors' precision/recall against seed_recent and asserting the shipped detector is the winner. Engineering LEAN (state as lean, confirm by match-rate): MigrateV2+CreatePool is structurally better (substring matching false-positives on unrelated instructions e.g. MigrateBondingCurveCreator, and silently breaks on protocol-version renames — the 'V2' implies exactly that happened, a plausible root cause of the near-zero post tagging).

SCORE OFFLINE WITHOUT RE-PULLING TX DATA (NO CREDITS — do NOT reach for Helius/Birdeye). Both detectors are run against LOCAL fixtures already on hand: the golden decoded-tx / helius_birth_tape samples (lake/golden/helius_decoded_txs/, lake/golden/helius_birth_tape/) and/or recorder logs/frames already captured — NEVER a fresh tx fetch. The corrected detector FIRES on a genuine MigrateV2 + CreatePool graduation frame and DOES NOT fire on a MigrateBondingCurveCreator fee-program frame or unrelated frames; the substring detector is shown to false-fire on the fee-program frame. Mint extraction is reconciled so the emitted mint equals the pre-grad TradeEvent SPL mint (the #366 getMultipleAccounts resolver path is RPC-gated -> mocked in tests this credit-free sprint, never called live). Verified by the offline test suite over the local fixtures; zero firehose / zero live RPC.

WHY THIS IS FOUNDATIONAL (fresh evidence) + LOCAL-PROOF. Operator pulled the firehose Jun 20-23: `phase=post` appears on only 13 swaps across 4 FULL days -> the deployed detector is missing ~ALL graduations, so the recorder cannot bank post-grad data. That blocks BOTH the copy ride-to-grad exit (US-83) AND the model's post-grad outcomes, and is why the backtest had to derive graduation from curve-SOL (the US-81 cum-vol_sol>=85 label). LOCAL-PROOF: a committed test/artifact cross-checks the shipped detector's firing rate against BOTH the seed_recent ground truth AND the free cum-vol_sol>=85 label on the local tapes — the shipped detector's grad count is in the realistic Dune order of magnitude (~190/day), NOT the ~2656/day false-positive rate of the old substring detector. The clean deploy (US-89) MUST ship the winning detector; live judging of the exit/model is impossible from day one without it. ALL prior scored tokens + model-edge reads taken before this fix are recorded INVALID. Zero firehose.

stories.title: PHASE B (RECORDER, CRITICAL) — Post-grad firehose rows must carry the token MINT: the recorder writes post rows with NO mint/pool/pair, so post-grad fills are unattributable offline and the live recorder can NEVER self-validate model PnL or the copy ride-to-grad exit -- gates US-89 deploy + US-91 soak

acceptance_criteria.text: ROOT CAUSE + FIX the recorder POST-GRAD write path (run_firehose.py post-grad tape emission and/or core/firehose/tape_sink.py) to emit `mint` on EVERY post row. Evidence: current post rows carry keys [block_time, owner, phase, price, rel, side, signature, slot, vol, vol_usd] with NO mint/pool/pair, so post-grad swaps are UNATTRIBUTABLE to a token offline (tokens interleave; `rel` is only per-token elapsed seconds with nothing to group on). The mint is available at the post-grad emission point (the post tape is keyed by the graduated token in memory) -- thread it onto the written row. Do NOT resolve mint from signature via RPC (that costs credits; the fix is a write-path field, not a lookup). Verified by a test asserting the post-grad write path includes a non-null mint field.

LOCAL-PROOF: a committed test asserts that on a LOCAL/recorder sample, every emitted post row carries a non-null `mint` and that the mint matches the graduated token it belongs to (the post-grad fill can be attributed to a token, so fill_repricing.py / the live recorder can settle it). The test runs against a recorder sample / fixture already on hand -- NO credits, NO tx re-pull, NO signature->mint RPC. The fix is forward-only (the historical mint-less Jun 20-23 post rows are NOT re-attributed -- they cannot be without credits; this is documented).

PER-PHASE DOLLAR-BASIS correctness confirmed + harness reconciled: POST rows already carry a populated vol_usd (the vol_usd=0 bug is PRE-rows ONLY), so the dollar basis is per-phase -- PRE dollars via vol_sol x SOL_price (US-81.3), POST dollars may use the row's own vol_usd (or vol_sol x SOL_price consistently; document the chosen rule, ONE place, config-driven). The US-81 harness is reconciled so post rows are treated as VALID (a `post` stream / correct phase tag), NOT partial-write corruption, and are excluded from the bad-line counter. GATING NOTE: this story GATES US-89 (clean deploy) and US-91 (observe soak) -- the soak cannot be judged by fill_repricing.py until post rows are attributable to a token. Zero firehose. Verified by a test over a recorder sample + a documented per-phase dollar rule.
